_doc: owner_plans.py (owner 2026-11-24): every EMA13xEMA20 cross simulated under a small set of executable trade plans; walk-forward learning of which plan (or skip) to use. Longs only for now (shorts: TODO, same-day square-off). All prices/decisions use only candles completed before the decision.

costs._doc: lane buy/sell costs are added; slippage per side in basis points, extra on stop / gap exits

entry._doc: NEXT_OPEN = buy the next candle's open. RETEST13 = limit at the last COMPLETED candle's EMA13, placed from the next candle; cancelled (checked at each candle's open on completed candles only) when EMA13 <= EMA20 again, a close is below the initial stop, or after max_wait candles.

stops._doc: SWING = last swing low confirmed by the cross candle (k candles each side, all completed), within lookback, below the cross close. PBLOW = lowest low of the last run of candles with EMA13 < EMA20 up to the cross candle. buffer_pct below the level.

management._doc: T2R flat at entry+2R. T200 flat at EMA200 (live: last completed candle's EMA200), eligible only when EMA200 is above the cross close with room >= min_room_r R. PT2R / PT200 = take partial_frac at that target, trail the rest on EMA20 TOUCH. TRAIL_TOUCH = stop = max(stop, previous completed EMA20) from the first candle after entry (never loosens), hit on touch. TRAIL_CLOSE = exit at the next open after a close below EMA20 (initial stop stays).

baselines._doc: Each baseline = one fixed plan id (entry|stop|management) or V2 (the old engine version from owner_strategy.json).

learn._doc: Walk-forward: at each cross only plan rows whose exit happened before the cross candle closed are used. refit_every = crosses between model refits. min_rows = closed rows a plan needs before it can be chosen (else 'insufficient evidence'). min_edge_r = expected net R needed to trade (else SKIP).
